description: Make a clean A4 invoice PDF: your business (logo, name, address, email, phone, tax ID), client, invoice number and dates, line items with quantity, unit price, per-line discount % and tax %, subtotal, discount, tax per rate and total, notes, payment terms, and an optional PAID stamp. Same maths as the website: every line is rounded to the currency's minor unit (2 decimals, 3 for JOD/KWD/BHD/OMR/TND…, 0 for JPY…) with half-up rounding; amounts formatted en-US style ($1,234.50, JOD 10.124). Long item lists continue on more pages. Returns the PDF path and the computed totals. Latin text only for now. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/invoice-maker/

from.description: Your business: name, email, phone, address, taxId.

items.description: Line items: desc, qty, price, disc %, tax %.

desc.description: Description of the product or service.

tax.description: Line tax rate in % (0-100), applied after the discount.

logo.description: Optional logo image: a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/SVG file path or base64. Drawn as-is (keep it small).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

paid.description: Mark as paid (shows "Amount paid" and a PAID stamp).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

terms.description: Payment terms shown at the bottom.

to.description: The client (bill to): name, email, address.

name: doc_invoice
title: Invoice PDF
